headline.title: We searched "physio Camp Hill Brisbane". Your own website appeared in none of the 17 results.
headline.detail: Yellow Pages, MyHealth1st, Fresha, Doctify and a mobile physio service filled the page; your booking page appeared once, in 10th place. You have 239 five-star reviews, more than any clinic nearby.

summary: Camp Hill Physio has 239 reviews, all five stars, and families who've trusted you for years. But in our search for a physio in Camp Hill, directories took the page and your own website didn't appear, while clinics on Old Cleveland Road and your own street compete for the same patients.

you.notes: Physio, EP, Pilates, dietitian; Sat mornings

search.result: Queensland Health's finder came first, then Yellow Pages (twice), MyHealth1st (twice), Fresha (three times), Doctify and Physio Inq. Your booking page appeared once; your website (camphillphysio.com.au) did not appear.
search.meaning: People looking for a physio in Camp Hill see directories that list many clinics, and you appear only once, halfway down.

visibility: In our search for a physio in Camp Hill, your booking page appeared once but your own website didn't. Directories that show several clinics side by side took most of the page.
lead: 239 reviews, all five stars: the most of any clinic we found nearby.
Physio, exercise physiology, reformer Pilates and a dietitian under one roof.
Long-term family loyalty: reviews mention years of care.
lose: Your own website didn't appear in our search; directories did.
A Pilates-physio studio on your own street is open until 7pm on Saturdays; you close at 12:30pm.
Clinics on Old Cleveland Road are on the main route people drive past.

gaps.title: Directories decide for you

gaps.title: Your Pilates and EP services are invisible

gaps.title: Saturday afternoon patients go elsewhere

actions.title: Make your own website the first result for Camp Hill

actions.title: Give Pilates rehab and exercise physiology their own pages
actions.why: People search for these by name; a clear page brings them straight to you.

actions.title: Link your website from every directory listing

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your team, specialties and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each visit, so happy patients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Reminders and recall
plan.detail: Follow-up and maintenance reminders that go out by themselves.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against nearby clinics, and what to do next.

scenario: A runner in Carina tears a calf during training for the Bridge to Brisbane. On Sunday evening she searches "physio Camp Hill", lands on a directory, and books the first clinic with Monday availability. The clinic with 239 five-star reviews and an exercise physiologist on staff never appeared. (Illustration.)
nochange: Families who know you keep coming. New patients searching for a physio in Camp Hill keep landing on directories that send them elsewhere.
